focus: Independent preservation scope, secret exclusion, and reproducibility review
evidence: preservation_manifest.json: 698 unique paths, 663 immutable evidence files, 27 source and 8 design snapshots
All 35 original source/design copies match their recorded SHA256
No manifest path is an .env file or a .key/.pem/.pfx/.p12 file
All three existing source PDFs and 171 existing run files are inventoried
preservation_supplement_phase1.json adds the three phase1 grading criteria and the shared review method
d0_review_3_hash_check.json: 702 total entries, 667 immutable evidence files, zero preservation violations

findings.finding: Original manifest did not cover phase1 grading criteria; build_r001_grade.py reads the HDMS criteria from phase1.
findings.resolution: The preservation reviewer added a separately timestamped immutable supplement and updated the verifier to check it, retaining the original manifest.

findings.finding: The tool rendering appeared to corrupt Korean git-status paths.
findings.resolution: Reading the actual UTF-8 JSON yielded zero U+FFFD characters and the correct Unicode code points. This was a display issue, not corruption of the record.

limitations: SHA256 preservation proves byte identity, not the factual correctness of historical gold or scores.
Secrets are excluded by filename/extension and no secret values were read or included in this review.
New files are intentionally outside the original baseline; their provenance must be recorded as new-version artifacts.
